نبذة

Waterlily brow & beauty studio has been in business for over 15 years. It was taken over by our senior dermal therapist and cosmetic tattooist Christine in January 2020. Christine has been in the beauty industry for 24 years and is passionate about all things beauty. All of our therapists are highly trained and dedicated in providing our valued clients with a memorable experience. Our fabulous location on Mandurah terrace has amazing views and ample street parking, we are directly opposite the foreshore park.
